title: tenant.membership_changed.v1
description: Someone's authority in a workspace changed. Sessions are invalidated from this, so it is emitted for a revocation as well as a grant; a revocation nobody hears is authority that outlives its removal.

change.description: What happened. Separate values rather than a role diff, because a consumer invalidating sessions cares about revocation and suspension and not about which role replaced which.

role.description: The role now held. Absent on revocation, where there is none.

previous_role.description: The role held before, for an audit trail that can answer what changed rather than only what it is now.
